title: CS2 World Bundle manifest (bundle.json)
description: The manifest at the root of a CS2 World Bundle. Fully specifies the coordinate frame, geo-referencing and layer index, so a consumer needs no game and no producer code.

game.description: Game build the bundle was ripped from. Diagnostic only; consumers must not branch on it.

city.description: City name, as displayed in game. May be empty in the map editor.

map.description: Map name, as displayed in game.

bounds.description: Axis-aligned bounds of all exported content, in the bundle frame.

mapSize.description: Playable map extent in metres (edge length of the square map).

counts.description: Element counts. A consumer may use these to pre-allocate and to detect truncated bundles.

layers.description: Layer index. Presence of a key means the layer was exported; absence means it was not. Every value is a bundle-root-relative POSIX path; values ending in '/' are directories.

rasters.description: Geo-referencing and value semantics of the raster layers. Required if any raster layer is present in 'layers'.

originWorld.description: Bundle-frame world position of the raster's top-left cell centre. Row 0 runs toward -Z (south).

elevationScale.description: Metres of world height per stored unit of the elevation rasters: worldY = value * elevationScale + elevationOffset. Required when a terrain layer is declared.

elevationOffset.description: World height of elevation-raster value 0, in metres.

noData.description: Sentinel value for cells with no data.

ripOptions.description: Provenance: the rip options actually in force for this export.

meshSource.description: Where mesh geometry came from. 'stub' means placeholder geometry was substituted; instance transforms are still authoritative.

lodCap.description: Highest LOD index exported per mesh. 0 = LOD0 only.

textureSizeCap.description: Longest texture edge in pixels after downscaling. 0 = uncapped.

relPath.description: Bundle-root-relative POSIX path to a file. No leading slash, no '..' segment.

relDir.description: Bundle-root-relative POSIX path to a directory, with a trailing slash.

frame.description: The coordinate frame of every position in this bundle. Stated literally so consumers convert deterministically.

meshFrame.description: glTF mandates a right-handed frame, so mesh payloads are stored converted. Instance transforms, bounds and rasters are NOT converted — they are raw bundle-frame values.

conversion.description: Applied to every vertex position, normal and tangent when writing meshes/*.glb and networks/*.glb.

windingReversed.description: Triangle winding was reversed to compensate for the mirror, so glTF front faces stay counter-clockwise.

geo.description: World-to-geographic anchoring. Applies to instance positions, mesh placements and rasters alike.

tmParams.description: Transverse-Mercator parameters, present when projection is TransverseMercator or UTM.

toWgs84.description: Helmert transform, 7 parameters (dx,dy,dz,rx,ry,rz,ds). All zero when none applies.

originLatLon.description: [latitude, longitude] in WGS84 of the point given by originWorld.

originProjected.description: [easting, northing] in 'crs' of the point given by originWorld.

originWorld.description: Bundle-frame position that originLatLon / originProjected refer to. Normally [0,0,0].

north.description: Degrees to rotate the bundle's +Z axis, counter-clockwise about +Y, to reach geographic north. 0 means +Z already points north.
